name: sec_insider_buy_filing_age_20261110
comment: LQ-20261107-1625. SEC_INSIDER_BUY used to select Form 4 rows by ingest time and
dedupe on (event type, symbol) for 4 hours, so a backfill of an old filing paged
urgent again after the cooldown. These tests pin the config-owned filing-age ceiling,
the accession parsed from the filing URL, and the refusal when the date or the
accession is missing. Fixtures are synthetic. The regime lag in the same policy file stays 0.
